import sys
import math

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 20:
        print(0)
        return
    p = [[0] * 5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(5):
            p[i][j] = int(next(it))
    good = []
    for i in range(n):
        ok = True
        for j in range(n):
            if not ok:
                break
            if i == j:
                continue
            for k in range(j + 1, n):
                if i == k:
                    continue
                angle = get_an(p[i], p[j], p[k])
                if angle < 90:
                    ok = False
                    break
        if ok:
            good.append(i + 1)
    out = [str(len(good))]
    out.extend(str(v) for v in good)
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

def get_an(p1, p2, p3):
    dot = 0.0
    aLen = 0.0
    bLen = 0.0
    for i in range(len(p1)):
        dot += (p2[i] - p1[i]) * (p3[i] - p1[i])
        aLen += (p2[i] - p1[i]) * (p2[i] - p1[i])
        bLen += (p3[i] - p1[i]) * (p3[i] - p1[i])
    return 180 * math.acos(dot / math.sqrt(aLen * bLen)) / math.pi

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
